chapter: After the Army: JATP, clubs and first Europe trips
title: Ocean crossings and a good stomach
summary: He compares the four-day crossing to France with the three-week voyage to China and says he never got seasick.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: What kind of boats did you go to China on then?
Five days to Honolulu, eighteen days to Japan, three more days to China.
And I've got a good stomache. I never did get seasick. But I've seen other people
A lot of times going to France, I'd be the only one in the dining room.
Well you've got a good stomache them.
I did then, I don't know if I have it now or not, I hope so.
You started with a good stomache.
